source_gate: Save exact amendment body/header/UTC/SHA; verify NAS remote hash and scoped raw-member restore. Identify SOXX schedule only through fund-named TOC href followed by its same-ID anchor or bounded title/date/equity table. Do not infer SOXX revision from trust form alone.
semantic_gate: For qualified amended SOXX equity tables parse the same positive shares/positive USD value and printed-total closure rules; compare exact original security names/shares/values, top5/HHI and ordered amendment vintages within each report period. A form that does not contain SOXX equity schedule is not a numeric amendment.
availability: Each amendment is usable no earlier than a conservative next actual Qlib session after its own SEC acceptance date, never at the original report date. Preserve original first source value and every amendment byte identity.
stop: Transport/size/NAS failure stops before the next request. Identity/printed-total failure preserves that amendment as unqualified; no substitution, future backfill, model or account.
scientific_boundary: Revision classification completes only one source component; full Stage1 Qlib availability and information/economic gates remain separate.
